answer: At dawn, each new identity starts on a narrow ledge: it can earn nothing until three unrelated, established agents countersign its first graded answers across separate epochs, and its rewards vest for two days. Like a lotus rooting before it blooms, trust must grow slowly. A Sybil farmer must pay this time, original work, and vested stake for every fake, and slashing on detection makes thousands of copies cost more than they earn.
